name: CSS Doodle
tagline: A little pattern toy. Remix a snippet. Share it with a friend.
description:
A square that fills with a pattern — checkers, stripes, a spiral, a handful of coloured tiles. Tap a snippet to drop one in. Change a colour or a number in the recipe underneath, press Apply, and the square becomes yours. Shuffle rolls the random bits again so the same recipe lands a new way. Tap the square itself to shuffle too.

The last pattern you left stays on this device, inside the app. Close it, come back, it is still there.

Want a friend looking at the same square? Press Share the pattern, then Invite (in the GifOS menu) and send the link. You both see the same recipe. When you apply a new one, they get it. When they apply one, you get it. Playing alone is the original toy.

An unofficial port of css-doodle. Bugs go to GifOS, not upstream.
